description: Warden ruleset v2 (T2.7). Same four rules and the same rule ids as v1; nothing in the conditions changes. What changes is what the proxy feeds R02 with and how R01's counter starts: (1) the notice fact is raised also by the game's own notifications about a foreign civ's win, in a closed list measured over the corpus, the demo and the Rome game (tools/fase0_extraer_hechos.py, GAME_NOTICE_LINES), not only by the harness's six templates; (2) the cadence counter of R01 is inherited per GAME from the previous session's sealed ledger (civ/proxy.py --continua), not reset per agent session; (3) the literal 20 of R01 is still the study playbook's own request [PAPER], not ours. Every rule still says what to LOOK AT or what to CLOSE, never what MOVE to make (DISENO section 4). v1 is kept for the Phase 0 replay. R04 is the verdict, and it lives here rather than in the replay code so that the ruleset hash anchors what counts as an intervention.

rules.name: Status check overdue by the cadence the playbook asks for
The harness or the game raised a notice and the agent has not looked since
A commitment the agent made is past its due turn and not closed
The turn does not close while an obligation is overdue
